Id.description: Unique identifier of the service overbooking limit.

FirstTimeUnitStartUtc.description: Start of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the first [time unit](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/time-units/), in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format.

LastTimeUnitStartUtc.description: End of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the last [time unit](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/time-units/), in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format.

Limit.description: Number of overbookings allowed for the `Service`.

CreatedUtc.description: Timestamp in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format when the service overbooking was created.

UpdatedUtc.description: Timestamp in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format when the service overbooking was updated.

IsActive.description: Whether the service overbooking limit is still active.
